policy: No owner-pending cohort may produce replace or revoke manifest items.

approvedDesignPrinciples.workflowDraftPolicy: regular users may edit or delete only their own draft; running instances are action-by-assignment

decisions.decisionRequired: Define application entry, workload submission, provider configuration, model administration, and sensitive-data boundaries with scopes.
Define dataset scopes and separate read, export, author, publish, share, and data-source administration.
Define visible audit domains and separate read/export from retention and administration.
Confirm application-entry semantics and separate conversation membership, moderation, channel administration, and platform configuration.
Map actors to project/site and Project Room actions; decide whether any residual global shell is intentionally required.
Separate self/team/department/company profile access from organization, payroll, and sensitive personnel administration.
Define own/assigned/department/global visibility and separate submit, review, approve, settle, and configuration actions.
Map contract lifecycle actions and confidential visibility to project/company scopes.
Define audience and record ownership; separate article authoring/publishing from object upload/delete, bucket, and retention controls.
Separate membership/read from sourcing, evaluation, approval, purchase-order, supplier, tender-workflow, and AI actions by scope.
Define own/participant/assigned/department/global visibility and separate template/category administration from submit, act, approve, and cancel.
Decompose general settings from security, integration, project-master, and warehouse-site binding controls; system.settings.manage is not directly grantable.
Separate catalog, custody, assignment, transfer, maintenance, stock, audit, and disposal actions with location/project scope.
Separate template read/edit/publish from instance start, act, administer, cancel, and reopen for initiator, participant, assignee, manager, and administrator.
Approve per-actor and per-warehouse replacement sets for the remaining WMS compatibility consumers; do not infer all WMS actions from the manage shell.
